items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I took Mushi's place -- that's Rudy Powell.

ctx.x: Well, we were ______, but you joined in 1947.
1947 I joined Cab Calloway's band, and I took Mushi's place -- that's Rudy Powell.
Rudy Powell, which he changed his name to Musa Kaleem, Mushi Kaweem.
